text_block_list.text: I've brought shame upon myself. I didn't even make it onto the scoreboard.

text_block_list.text: There's no excuse—it's a case of pure insufficiency. I really do have a long way to go…

text_block_list.text: With my mentor placing such faith in me, this is no time to halt my progress!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll achieve great results in my next race and repay your kindness!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Competing against formidable opponents will help me grow stronger. The mere thought has my heart racing.

text_block_list.text: Thank you. I shall return to the basics and redouble my efforts!
